subject: Post-renewal usage reckoning & one-time makeup offer
messages:
From: Mia Alvarez <mia@stellara.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@stellara.io
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-renewal spike — request for reconciliation and one-off charge

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from our side — after our renewal (effective 10/01) we saw a large unexpected spike in inference hours tied to a canary rollout. We pulled the attached usage CSV for October. The spike pushed us ~65% over our committed capacity for the month and Finance is asking for an itemized true-up so we can close the books.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm Redwood's usage accounting for Oct and the exact units you'll invoice for the overage?
- We'd like a proposal for a one-time make-good (credit or amortized discount) — our CFO prefers amortized credits across the next two invoices but will consider a single credit if needed.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our month-end is Nov 10.

Thanks,
Mia Alvarez
Head of Infrastructure, Stellara
mia@stellara.io
Stellara, Inc.

Attachment: Stellara_usage_Oct2026.csv (CSV, 1 file)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-renewal spike — request for reconciliation and one-off charge

Hi Mia — thanks for flagging this and for the attached CSV. We're sorry this caused extra work at your end. We're reviewing the logs now. Quick notes:

- Ben will validate the raw inference-hour aggregation and the mapping to your committed pool.
- Karthik will review contract language and confirm the correct overage calculation (per-token vs. per-hour mapping).
- We can propose either a one-time credit or a two-invoice amortization; we'll include both options in the proposal.

Can you confirm if the attached CSV is the same report your billing team expects (hourly bins + model id + region)? If not, tell us what format Finance needs.

I aim to get an initial reconciliation proposal by EOD Friday (Nov 6) so you have time before your Nov 10 close.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-renewal spike — request for reconciliation and one-off charge

Vanessa / Karthik / Mia —

I've run the usage reconciliation against our served logs and the Stellara CSV. Summary:
- Confirmed spike window: 2026-10-12 02:00 — 2026-10-12 11:00 PDT (approx).
- Total incremental inference-hours outside committed capacity: 42,750 token-hours (our billing unit conversion applied).
- Based on Stellara's committed pool (monthly cap: 65k token-hours) the net overage for Oct = 18,500 token-hours.

Evidence files: aggregated_hourly_counts.csv (internal) and alignment notes. I attached the human-readable summary below.

Proposal options for Stellara:
1) One-time credit: 20% of the overage invoice total, applied as a single credit on the Nov invoice (amount TBD; I calculate ~$14,800 pre-tax).
2) Amortized credit: 50% of the one-time credit now, 50% applied to the following invoice (Dec). This spreads the benefit across two billing cycles.
3) Capacity uplift offer: If Stellara commits to a 25% capacity increase for the next 6 months, Redwood will waive the one-time credit and convert the overage into a discounted top-up commitment (we'd need a short amendment).

I'll attach the interim reconciliation CSV to our internal record. Vanessa, I recommend offering option 2 as primary, option 3 as a commercial upsell, and option 1 if Finance insists on a single settlement.

-ben

Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment referenced internally: aggregated_hourly_counts.csv

From: Mia Alvarez <mia@stellara.io>

Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-renewal spike — request for reconciliation and one-off charge

Thanks, Ben — this is helpful and clearer than our internal pass.

A couple of clarifying points from Finance:
- They prefer the amortized route (your option 2).
- They will accept the capacity uplift offer only if we sign an amendment with an explicit monthly minimum and a 10% discount on the added capacity.
- They asked if Redwood can provide a short signed amendment (one page) that lists the added capacity, the discount, and the start date. If we go that route they'd like the credit converted into an initial-month waiver rather than a cash credit.

We are comfortable with the amortized option but would like you to send the firm numbers (credit amount, how it appears on invoice) so Finance can close this. Also — please send any amendment draft if option 3 is on the table.

Attached: Stellara_usage_Oct2026.csv (same as sent earlier)

Best,
Mia

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-renewal spike — request for reconciliation and one-off charge

Mia — thanks for the direction. Per Ben's reconciliation, we ran final figures and prepared the settlement package. Actions and numbers below:

- Final overage invoiceable units: 18,500 token-hours = $29,600 (USD) pre-tax based on your rate card.
- One-time credit calculation: proposed 20% credit = $5,920.
- Agreed amortized approach (preferred): apply $2,960 credit to Nov invoice and $2,960 to Dec invoice. The invoices will show a line item "Stellara Oct 2026 Overage Credit (20% amortized)" with respective amounts.
- Capacity uplift amendment (option 3): draft attached for review. Key points: +25% monthly capacity for 6 months, 10% discount on incremental capacity, start date 2026-12-01, amendment ID: AMEND-STR-2026-11. If you sign the amendment and return by Nov 20, we'll waive the $5,920 credit and instead apply a first-month waiver for the added capacity.

I've attached the signed amendment stub (signed-amendment-Stellara-Nov2026.pdf) and a DocuSign link for acceptance. Please confirm which option Finance prefers and we'll route the Nov invoice accordingly.

Thanks for working through this quickly — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
